entry.title: Digital-Omnibus: Verhandlungsmandat des Rates
entry.summary: ST 14756/26 of 22 October 2026 is a note of the General Secretariat of the Council with the text of the mandate for negotiations with the European Parliament on the Digital Omnibus, as agreed by the Permanent Representatives Committee on 21 October 2026; it is a negotiating mandate, not an adopted act, and the text can still change in the negotiations. Against the Presidency compromise text of 3 September 2026 (ST 12535/26) the incident reporting provisions (information point at ENISA, national entry points) are essentially unchanged, while the recitals on funding and design of the national entry points are adjusted. The new wording concerns mainly the Data Act (rules on refusing access to trade secrets, with notification to the authority every three months and Commission guidelines), the GDPR (pseudonymisation, AI processing, data subject requests), the ePrivacy Directive (exceptions and consent rules for terminal equipment) and the application dates. None of the tracked concepts is touched.

entry.title: NIS-2: Kommission plant einen Durchführungsrechtsakt
entry.summary: The NIS2 Directive sets out obligations on essential and important entities in 18 critical sectors in the EU for the reporting of significant cybersecurity incidents. This act will provide common incident notification templates for notifications under the NIS2 Directive, thereby streamlining the format and the type of information to be notified across all 27 Member States and supporting the Commission’s broader simplification agenda. Förmlicher Titel: Commission Implementing Regulation further specifying the type of information, the format and the procedure of a notification submitted pursuant to Article 23(1) of Directive (EU) 2022/2555. Die Kommission erlässt ihn nach der Stellungnahme der Mitgliedstaaten im Ausschuss „Cybersecurity Committee“ (Verfahren: examination procedure (Art. 5, 6 and 7 of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011)). Ein Entwurf soll auf „Have your say“ zur Rückmeldung veröffentlicht werden.
